title: Interface molecular orientation engineering-induced field reversal for efficient inverted perovskite solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02667A, Paper
Suhao Yan, Bo Zhang, Wenguang Zhang, Kun Chen, Zijuan He, Yang Sun, Haipeng Yin, Zi Ouyang, Xin Li, Bo Xiao
PMEAI is introduced at the perovskite/C60 interface to simultaneously passivate defects, enhance charge extraction, and suppress Ag+ migration. The resulting inverted PSCs deliver a certified PCE of 25.84% and outstanding operational stability.
